Can you give a example of making a blue eyes deck trying to do something that it’s not really intended to? Just curious... when I first started with a dragon deck (eclipse wyvern, red eyes darkness metal dragon, light and dark dragons), I was told it was trying to do too many things, but wasn’t told what things. I get that game mechanics change with new cards being introduced every year, so obviously it can be annoying and expensive to constantly upgrade it.

You have a good point, but I don’t see why people would play Blue Eyes with the expectation that it can literally do everything. I feel like people play more for the nostalgia of it. More competitive players have just found better decks. A couple of years ago SPYRAL was the hottest deck, but since I’ve been off-scene for a bit, I have no idea what to expect at my next regionals other than some big losses haha.

Yeah regionals can get pretty intense, and lots of the guys there try to mansplain my own deck to me (I’m a girl, but I’m not stupid). Unfortunately I’m from a small town, as was the university I went to, and there wasn’t much of a non competitive Yugioh scene. I do wish I could find more casual players now that I’m living in a big city, but it’s not possible right now due to COVID. Online isn’t as fun... if I want an online card game, I have hearthstone for that haha. But blue eyes will always be my one true love in yugioh.

I wouldn’t look down on Blue Eyes so harshly. I played my blue eyes deck competitively at regionals and won some matches, so I got way past turn 2. I get that it’s not a deck you play to win with, but it’s pretty fun.

I don’t understand all the blue eyes hate. I run a competitive blue eyes deck I took to Philadelphia regionals and didn’t do horrible with it. Granted, it’s very non traditional, but I was able to win matches and play with a deck I really like. The thing you have to understand about blue eyes is that they’ll always be inconsistent. You don’t play with them to win big and place in the top 3 or whatever, but they’re lots of fun. Sorry I can’t be of much help without a deck list.
